copy of Medwin Medwin virtually asserts that he was responsible for both the Athenaeum
and Fraser’s publications (see Ernest J. Lovell, Captain Medwin (1962) 328 and note), and
also confirms that Mary Shelley was not aware of the Fraser’s text when preparing 1839,
where she prints the Athenaeum text, and like Medwin, omits Jane’s name. Medwin’s texts
differ in various respects from Jane’s holograph, but not in ways that suggest a different
source. With a guitar is printed complete, and obviously from Jane’s MS, in 1840, pre-
